text:
Alex: Heads-up — marketplace launch with AtlasSys next week. Need to finalize partner SEV path + shared channel name. Can we align?
Maria: Thanks Alex. Leaning towards a shared channel + short-lived war room for launch. Suggest naming convention: #partner-atlassys-sev -> but open to alternatives. :eyes:
Ben: Prefer #partner-atlas-warroom to match earlier launches. Also we need a hotline rotation and a single primary partner liaison for triage.
Samir: @Maria @Alex I drafted a quick escalation matrix, PTAL.
Samir: ```
P1: immediate bridge + dual-page (partners-liaison + SRE oncall)
P2: same-day async in shared channel + partner-liaison escalation if no ack
P3: open ticket, 24h SLA for partner-facing reply
```
Jess: We need a runbook link pinned in the channel. I'll request perms if anyone can't access: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-sev
partners-bot: Bridge created: #warroom-partner-atlas-3182468100 (auto-expire 48h) — invited: Alex, Maria, Ben, Samir, Jess
Alex: Nice. Who's liaison for US daytime? @Ben?
Ben: I can cover daytime Wed-Fri. Maria covers Mon-Tue. @Samir can be escalation owner evenings/weekends.
Samir: Confirmed. For P1 we page SRE immediately — need oncall contact in the channel. Also recommend adding the SI support phone and escalation email to the pinned card.
oncall-sre: Copy. We'll be on standby for the launch window. Please run: `/ops attach runbook partner-sev-v2` in the warroom to attach the checklist.
Maria: Also propose a pinned SI contact card format: Name / Role / Slack handle / 24h escalation number / preferred vendor portal link. Do NOT put any secrets or OAuth tokens.
Alex: Agreed. For announcement coordination, keep comms in #partners-announcements and only move into warroom for SEVs. Jess — can you draft two canned comms (customer-impact / non-customer-impact)?
Jess: On it. I'll post drafts in #partners-announcements and link them here.
Ben: One last item — postmortem ownership: partner-liaison + SRE lead to co-own, with marketing review for customer comms.
Samir: I'll update the runbook with the liaison rotation block and add the paging escalation snippet.
Alex: Thanks team. Action items: Ben/Maria confirm liaison calendar, Jess preps comms, Samir updates runbook, partners-bot holds warroom for 48h. We'll do a quick sync 30m before launch. :white_check_mark:
